observations: Two high-back armchairs with dark grey or black fabric upholstery.
The chairs have tapered dark wooden legs.
Photo 0 shows the rear view of both chairs side-by-side.
Photo 1 shows a rear-quarter view of one chair.
The fabric appears to be a plush or velvet-like material.
There are no photos showing the front of the chairs, the seats, or the inner backrests.

claims.evidence: The items are fixed-leg armchairs, not typical swivel office chairs with wheels.
Only the back of the chairs is shown; the condition of the seat and front is unknown.
The primary wear surfaces (seat and front) are not visible.

risks.risk: Significant wear, stains, or tears on the seat and front upholstery
risks.proof: A clear photo of the front of the chairs showing the seats and inner backrests.

risks.risk: Structural instability or broken internal frame
risks.proof: A video of someone sitting in the chairs or applying pressure to the armrests.

proof_requests: Photos of the front of the chairs showing the seats and the inner backrests.
Photos of the armrests from the top and front.
A photo of the underside of one chair to inspect the frame and leg attachments.
response.reason: The seller has only provided photos of the back of the chairs. It is impossible to assess the condition of the seats and front upholstery, which are the most critical areas for valuation.
